# Silicon Tundra

> Silicon Tundra is the AI and Automation Navigator for Lifestyle Medicine. We help med spas,
> plastic surgery practices, chiropractors, dental and orthodontic offices, IV wellness clinics,
> and men's health/TRT clinics automate workflows and adopt smarter tools — so their teams spend
> more time on patient care.

Website: https://www.silicontundrallc.com
Contact: jon@silicontundrallc.com

## Services

- The 24/7 Receptionist — AI receptionist systems that answer every inbound call, qualify leads,
  book appointments, and respond after hours so no patient hits voicemail.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services#receptionist
- AI Agent Development — custom AI agents for patient follow-up, intake reminders, reactivation
  campaigns, lead qualification, review requests, and internal admin workflows.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services#agents
- AI & Automation Consulting — audits that find wasted hours, missed revenue, and manual
  workflows inside lifestyle medicine practices.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services#consulting
- AI Product Studio — custom web apps (dashboards, client portals, booking tools, lead
  management, MVPs) built from your workflows. You bring the problem; we build the product.
  https://www.silicontundrallc.com/services#product-studio
